---
title: "hydrovur test"
output: html_document
---

This notebook exercises every public function in `hydrovur` against the live
HydroVu API and an AWS Postgres database. It uses the site / sensor / gage
inventory from the upstream `global.R`, inlined so the script is self-contained.

**Run interactively, chunk by chunk** — don't knit blindly. The sync chunks
write to a real database table (`gage_readings_smoketest`), and the cleanup
chunk drops it.

Required environment variables: `HYDROVU_CLIENT_ID`, `HYDROVU_CLIENT_SECRET`,
`SECRET_MANAGER_SECRET_NAME`.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
devtools::load_all()  # use dev version, not installed
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(DBI)
```

  "Piezometer",      "PZ-A2",    "Piezometer A2",             "E, 1000 ft S of Clear Lake",

  "PZ-B2",      "2025PZB02",     "troll",
  "PZ-B3",      "2025PZB03",     "troll",

## Connect

`hv_connect()` authenticates and (with `prime = TRUE`) eagerly populates the
locations and parameters caches.

```{r connect}
stopifnot(
  nzchar(Sys.getenv("HYDROVU_CLIENT_ID")),
  nzchar(Sys.getenv("HYDROVU_CLIENT_SECRET"))
)

con <- hv_connect()
con
```

## Inspect cached state

```{r cached-locations}
hv_locations(con)
```

```{r cached-parameters}
hv_parameters(con)
```

A quick check that every `hydrovu_loc` in `sensors` resolves to a HydroVu location:

```{r resolve-names}
missing <- setdiff(sensors$hydrovu_loc, hv_locations(con)$name)
if (length(missing) == 0L) {
  message("All ", nrow(sensors), " sensor names resolve to HydroVu locations.")
} else {
  warning("Missing from HydroVu: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
}
```

## Filter to stage gages

```{r filter-gages}
gage_locs <- hv_locations(con) |>
  filter(name %in% sensors$hydrovu_loc[sensors$site_category == "Stage Gage"])

piezo_locs <- hv_locations(con) |>
  filter(name %in% sensors$hydrovu_loc[sensors$site_category == "Piezometer"])

print(gage_locs)
stopifnot(nrow(gage_locs) > 0L)
```

## Fetch a small readings sample

Two locations over a recent hour, quick round-trip to confirm the shape.

```{r fetch-sample}
# wrapped in with_options for verbose messaging
sample_readings <- withr::with_options(list(hydrovur.verbose = TRUE), 
  hv_readings(
    con,
    location_ids = head(gage_locs$location_id, 2),
    start        = Sys.time() - hours(24),
    end          = Sys.time() - hours(23)
  )
  )

sample_readings |>
  left_join(gage_locs |> select(location_id, name), by = "location_id") |>
  count(name, parameter_name, unit_id, name = "n_readings") |>
  arrange(name, parameter_name)
```

Expected columns on `sample_readings`: `location_id`, `parameter_id`, 
`unit_id`, `timestamp`, `value`.

```{r check-shape}
stopifnot(
  setequal(
    names(sample_readings),
    c("location_id", "parameter_id", "parameter_name",
      "unit_id", "timestamp", "value")
  )
)
```

## Set up DB connection

Same AWS Secrets Manager + pool pattern as the original `helpers.R`.

```{r db-setup, message=FALSE}
library(paws)
library(RPostgres)
library(pool)

secret <- paws::secretsmanager()$get_secret_value(
  SecretId = Sys.getenv("SECRET_MANAGER_SECRET_NAME")
)$SecretString |>
  jsonlite::fromJSON()

db <- pool::dbPool(
  drv      = RPostgres::Postgres(),
  host     = if ("host"   %in% names(secret)) secret$host   else
               "interoperable-flows-db.ctfqkslimkx4.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com",
  port     = 5432,
  dbname   = if ("dbname" %in% names(secret)) secret$dbname else "postgres",
  user     = secret$username,
  password = secret$password,
  sslmode  = "require",
  timezone = "UTC"   # session + returned POSIXct both UTC
)
```

## DB helpers in isolation

Use a dedicated test table so we don't touch production data.

```{r test-table}
TEST_TABLE <- "test_hydrovu_readings"

# create
hv_ensure_table(db, TEST_TABLE)

# empty on a fresh table
hv_last_timestamps(db, TEST_TABLE)
```

## Sync a small window

Three explicit steps: compute windows, fetch, validate + upsert.

```{r first-sync-windows}
windows <- hv_compute_windows(
  db, gage_locs, table = TEST_TABLE,
  fresh_start_days = 1,
  overlap_days     = 1
)
windows
```

```{r first-sync-get-readings}
new_readings <- hv_readings(
  con,
  location_ids = windows$location_id,
  start        = windows$start_ts,
  end          = windows$end_ts
)
nrow(new_readings)
new_readings |> head()
```

```{r first-sync-execute}
hv_sync(db, new_readings, table = TEST_TABLE)
```

## Idempotency

Re-running should produce the same row count in the table (existing rows
update in place rather than duplicate).

```{r idempotent}
row_count <- function() {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(
    db,
    glue::glue_sql("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM {`TEST_TABLE`}", .con = db)
  )$n |> as.integer()  # COUNT(*) is integer64
}

before <- row_count()

windows  <- hv_compute_windows(db, gage_locs, table = TEST_TABLE,
                               fresh_start_days = 1, overlap_days = 1)
readings <- hv_readings(con, windows$location_id,
                        windows$start_ts, windows$end_ts)
hv_sync(db, readings, table = TEST_TABLE)

after <- row_count()

cat("rows before second sync:", before, "\n",
    "rows after  second sync:", after,  "\n")
stopifnot(before == after)
```

## Per-location coverage

```{r coverage}
hv_last_timestamps(db, TEST_TABLE) |>
  left_join(gage_locs |> select(location_id, name), by = "location_id") |>
  select(name, location_id, last_ts) |>
  arrange(name)
```

## Timezone check

Every timestamp the package hands back should be labelled UTC, regardless of
the R session's local timezone.

```{r utc-check}
stopifnot(
  identical(attr(sample_readings$timestamp, "tzone"), "UTC"),
  identical(attr(windows$start_ts, "tzone"), "UTC"),
  identical(attr(windows$end_ts, "tzone"), "UTC"),
  identical(attr(hv_last_timestamps(db, TEST_TABLE)$last_ts, "tzone"), "UTC")
)
```

## Cleanup

Drops the test table and releases the pool.

```{r cleanup, eval=FALSE}
DBI::dbExecute(db, glue::glue_sql("DROP TABLE {`TEST_TABLE`}", .con = db))
pool::poolClose(db)
```
